local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local player=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local automation=gui:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation',5)
assert(automation,'missing PunchWallClientAutomation')
local settings=automation:Invoke('SetSettings',{motion=true,sound=true,uiScale=1,persist=false})
assert(settings and settings.motion==true,'failed to enable normal motion')
local root=workspace:WaitForChild('PunchWallRPG')
local block=root:WaitForChild('Depth Blocks'):WaitForChild('DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02')
local GameConfig=require(RS:WaitForChild('GameConfig'))
local blockCoinReward=tonumber(block:GetAttribute('CoinReward')) or 0
local expectedCoins=GameConfig.ContributionReward(blockCoinReward,1)
assert(blockCoinReward>0 and expectedCoins>0,'invalid replicated contribution reward contract')
local previous=shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe
if previous and previous.connection then previous.connection:Disconnect() end
local coinFolder=workspace:FindFirstChild('Local Coin Rewards')
local probe={events={},alias=block.Name,expectedCoins=expectedCoins,feedbackBefore=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0,coinBurstBefore=gui:GetAttribute('CoinBurstTotal') or 0,rewardSequenceBefore=gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0,liveCoinsBefore=coinFolder and #coinFolder:GetChildren() or 0}
probe.connection=RS:WaitForChild('PunchWallEvents'):WaitForChild('Feedback').OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
 if typeof(payload)=='table' then
  table.insert(probe.events,{type=tostring(payload.type or ''),target=tostring(payload.target or ''),coins=tonumber(payload.coins) or 0,wallBreak=payload.wallBreak==true})
 end
end)
shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe=probe
return H:JSONEncode({ready=true,normalMotion=settings.motion==true,alias=probe.alias,expectedCoins=probe.expectedCoins,feedbackBefore=probe.feedbackBefore,coinBurstBefore=probe.coinBurstBefore,rewardSequenceBefore=probe.rewardSequenceBefore,liveCoinsBefore=probe.liveCoinsBefore})

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local command = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("PunchWallAutomation")
local player = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
assert(player, "missing test player")
command:Invoke("Reset")
command:Invoke("SetStats", { Power = 120, Coins = 0, WallLevel = 1, CritChance = 0, FistMultiplier = 1, PetMultiplier = 0 })
player:SetAttribute("CoinBoostExpiresAt", 0)
local root = workspace:WaitForChild("PunchWallRPG")
local block = root:WaitForChild("Depth Blocks"):WaitForChild("DepthBlock_L001_C06_R02")
local blockCoinReward = tonumber(block:GetAttribute("CoinReward")) or 0
local expectedCoins = GameConfig.ContributionReward(blockCoinReward, 1)
local beforeCoins = player.leaderstats.Coins.Value
local result = command:Invoke("BreakWall", "Brick Wall", 1)
local resultingCoins = tonumber(result and result.Coins) or -1
local outcome = tostring(result and result.outcome or "")
local aliasIsCurrent = block:GetAttribute("IsDepthBlock") == true and block:GetAttribute("Tier") == 1 and block:GetAttribute("Depth") == 1
local boostCleared = (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CoinBoostExpiresAt")) or -1) == 0 and tonumber(result and result.CoinBoostExpiresAt) == 0
local expectedPositive = blockCoinReward > 0 and expectedCoins > 0
local exactReward = beforeCoins == 0 and resultingCoins == expectedCoins and player.leaderstats.Coins.Value == expectedCoins
local rewardValid = result ~= nil and result.ok == true and aliasIsCurrent and boostCleared and expectedPositive and result.BrickWallBroken == true and outcome == "broken" and exactReward
return HttpService:JSONEncode({ ok = result and result.ok == true, alias = block.Name, blockCoinReward = blockCoinReward, expectedCoins = expectedCoins, coins = resultingCoins, boostCleared = boostCleared, expectedPositive = expectedPositive, exactReward = exactReward, BrickWallBroken = result and result.BrickWallBroken == true, outcome = outcome, rewardValid = rewardValid })

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local gui=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local probe=shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe
assert(probe,'missing punch reward feedback probe')
if probe.connection then probe.connection:Disconnect() probe.connection=nil end
shared.PunchWallRewardFeedbackProbe=nil
local punchIndex,rewardIndex
for index,event in ipairs(probe.events) do
 if not punchIndex and event.type=='Punch' and event.target==probe.alias then punchIndex=index end
 if not rewardIndex and event.type=='Reward' and event.target==probe.alias then rewardIndex=index end
end
local rewardEvent=rewardIndex and probe.events[rewardIndex] or nil
local ordered=punchIndex~=nil and rewardIndex~=nil and punchIndex<rewardIndex
local rewardExact=rewardEvent~=nil and rewardEvent.wallBreak==true and rewardEvent.coins==probe.expectedCoins
local feedbackDelta=(gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0)-probe.feedbackBefore
local feedbackCovers=feedbackDelta>=#probe.events and #probe.events>=2
local lastBurst=tonumber(gui:GetAttribute('LastCoinBurstCount')) or 0
local burstDelta=(tonumber(gui:GetAttribute('CoinBurstTotal')) or 0)-probe.coinBurstBefore
local burstValid=lastBurst>=1 and lastBurst<=7 and burstDelta>=lastBurst
local coinFolder=workspace:FindFirstChild('Local Coin Rewards')
local liveCoins=coinFolder and #coinFolder:GetChildren() or -1
local liveBounded=coinFolder~=nil and liveCoins>=0 and liveCoins<=30
local normalMotion=gui:GetAttribute('LastMotionApplied')==true and gui:GetAttribute('ReducedMotionCoinTravelSuppressed')==false
local centerDisabled=gui:GetAttribute('CenterActionFeedbackEnabled')==false
local rewardSequenceDelta=(gui.RewardPops:GetAttribute('PresentationSequence') or 0)-probe.rewardSequenceBefore
local noCenterReward=rewardSequenceDelta==0
local valid=ordered and rewardExact and feedbackCovers and burstValid and liveBounded and normalMotion and centerDisabled and noCenterReward
return H:JSONEncode({valid=valid,normalMotion=normalMotion,ordered=ordered,eventCount=#probe.events,punchIndex=punchIndex or 0,rewardIndex=rewardIndex or 0,alias=probe.alias,expectedCoins=probe.expectedCoins,rewardCoins=rewardEvent and rewardEvent.coins or -1,rewardWallBreak=rewardEvent and rewardEvent.wallBreak==true or false,rewardExact=rewardExact,feedbackDelta=feedbackDelta,feedbackCovers=feedbackCovers,lastBurst=lastBurst,burstDelta=burstDelta,burstValid=burstValid,liveCoins=liveCoins,liveBounded=liveBounded,centerDisabled=centerDisabled,rewardSequenceDelta=rewardSequenceDelta,noCenterReward=noCenterReward,terminalType=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') or ''),terminalTarget=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') or '')})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RS=game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local player=game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild('PlayerGui'):WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local GameConfig=require(RS:WaitForChild('GameConfig'))
local feedbackType=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackType') or '')
local target=tostring(gui:GetAttribute('LastFeedbackTarget') or '')
local baseName,stars=GameConfig.ParsePetToken(target)
local definition=GameConfig.PetDefinition(baseName)
local catalogIndex=0
for index,pet in ipairs(GameConfig.Pets) do
 if pet.name==baseName then catalogIndex=index break end
end
local premium=false
for _,pet in ipairs(GameConfig.PremiumPets) do
 if pet.name==baseName then premium=true break end
end
local canonical=GameConfig.PetToken(baseName,stars)==target
local starsValid=stars==1 and stars>=1 and stars<=GameConfig.MaxPetStars
local inventoryValue=player:WaitForChild('RPGStats'):WaitForChild('PetInventoryJSON').Value
local decoded,inventory=pcall(function() return H:JSONDecode(inventoryValue) end)
if not decoded or type(inventory)~='table' then inventory={} end
local inventoryContains=table.find(inventory,target)~=nil
local petValid=feedbackType=='Pet' and definition~=nil and catalogIndex>0 and not premium and starsValid and canonical and inventoryContains
return H:JSONEncode({petValid=petValid,type=feedbackType,target=target,baseName=baseName,stars=stars,starsValid=starsValid,canonical=canonical,definitionExists=definition~=nil,hatchCatalog=catalogIndex>0,catalogIndex=catalogIndex,premium=premium,rarity=definition and definition.rarity or '',inventoryContains=inventoryContains,inventoryCount=#inventory,count=gui:GetAttribute('FeedbackCount') or 0})

steps.label: pet feedback is a canonical current hatch token replicated into inventory
